integrity: The exact 1984 publication date was verified from PubMed. A complete open 2011 same-object article was inspected for the exact equations, slow-fast geometry, periodic and chaotic bursting, spike adding, homoclinic bifurcations, Lyapunov diagnostics, and multistability; targeted full-text searches found no matching conditional, moment, covariance, or variance theorem. Same-object integrability, reflecting-function, and modern stability literature were compared at statement and implication level. The three conditional regressions, variance defects, covariance identities, support implication, and equality-rigidity cases were independently reconstructed, and their algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not establish global boundedness for every parameter set.
The half-space constraint \(y\le c\) is necessary for compact stationary support, not a bifurcation criterion.
The exact correlations do not determine the full invariant density, spike counts, or burst timing.
The 1984 foundational article is used for provenance and date rather than exhaustive whole-document noncoverage.
The retrieved 2023 perturbation article did not expose every body-text line, so it is not used for blanket noncoverage.
A differently phrased short invariant-measure identity could remain in unindexed neuronal-dynamics literature.
title: Exact recovery–adaptation regressions and sign-locked correlations in Hindmarsh–Rose bursting
